Includes an integrated Super-Prompt Studio to squeeze high-end results out of free models with zero subscription fees.

records.name: Aglyn
records.tagline: The visual builder with a real platform underneath
records.description: Design your site on a live canvas, then run commerce, forms, media, workflows, email, and analytics from one console. Open source (Apache-2.0): self-host with Docker or start free on the hosted platform. No developer required.

records.name: Calgrove AI
records.tagline: Stop guessing. Start tracking what you eat with AI.
records.description: Calgrove AI makes calorie tracking ridiculously simple. Instead of spending your day searching for foods and entering grams, use AI to understand what you eat and keep track of your calories and nutrition. Built for people who want to eat better, lose weight, or stay on top of their goals without turning every meal into a spreadsheet.

records.name: DC Procure
records.tagline: Get There Before the Bid. Before the Competition.
records.description: DC Procure helps suppliers, contractors, and infrastructure teams find U.S. data center opportunities before the RFP. Track projects by developer, MW, stage, source-backed activity, organizations, decision-makers, and site context to see what’s actually progressing — and where there’s still time to influence the opportunity.

records.name: StartupWiki
records.tagline: The free startup database powered by AI
records.description: StartupWiki uses AI research agents to investigate and maintain startup profiles automatically. Search companies, track emerging startups, export research, and explore startup ecosystems through a constantly evolving knowledge base built for founders, investors, and builders. Our profils are free for the community, unlike crunchbase or pitchbook.

records.name: Money Map Plus
records.tagline: Save. Plan. Together.
records.description: For saving and planning together. Set savings goals to go on holidays, buy your first home, fund future adventures, gather totals of your money, assets, including non-conventional things into one place to plan for what's next. We believe that money and savings should be done in private. So we've built the app around this; with no ads, no tracking, no algorithms, no accounts, fully end-to-end encrypted if sharing. Save. Plan. Together - privately and simply with Money Map Plus.

records.name: DevEngine AI
records.tagline: Get pure HTML/JS sites with live database in seconds
records.description: Stop dealing with bloated frameworks and complex build steps. DevEngine AI turns your ideas into production-ready, dependency-free HTML/CSS/JS websites integrated with Supabase. Featuring autonomous self-healing QA, visual click-to-edit tools, and 1-click Vercel deployment—from simple prompt to live website in seconds.

records.name: sidebranch
records.tagline: Easy git-based visual diffing
records.description: Review PRs from inside your running app: switch branches from an in-page widget and compare worktrees side by side. Loopback-only, zero dependencies.

records.name: DocuPure
records.tagline: 100% Client-side, privacy-first online PDF toolkit
records.description: Merge, split, compress, and edit PDFs directly in your browser with zero server uploads.

records.name: seenpaid
records.tagline: see which posts made money, not which got likes
records.description: A social media scheduler that reports revenue, not vanity metrics. Plan and cross-post to 23 platforms — X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, Bluesky — from one content calendar. Connect Stripe, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy or Whop, and every tracked link traces clicks and sales back to the exact post that earned them. 47 MCP tools let Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor run your scheduling and revenue reporting end to end.

records.name: BeatDesign
records.tagline: Open-source Higgsfield Canvas for any MCP agent
records.description: BeatDesign is a local, open-source alternative to Higgsfield Canvas. Studio, Canvas, Assets, generation history, and a short-form Editor live in one project on your disk. Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP-capable agent can operate it through 26 local tools. Files stay local until you confirm generation.

records.name: NextPAI
records.tagline: Stop starting from scratch — a persistent AI workspace.
records.description: NextPAI is a persistent AI workspace for managers, founders, and operators — not AI experts. It connects prebuilt AI specialists, a memory layer where relevant context can carry forward across sessions, and a Daily Briefing into one workspace, so different parts of your work build on each other instead of standing alone. Ask naturally, get structured guidance, and keep your momentum from session to session.

records.name: WhatsKit
records.tagline: Free WhatsApp Tools for Links, Text, Images & More
records.description: WhatsKit is a free collection of practical tools built for everyday WhatsApp-related tasks. Create WhatsApp links, generate and format text, work with images, create QR codes, generate useful content, and handle other common tasks directly in your browser. Why WhatsKit? • Free to use • Simple and beginner-friendly • Mobile-friendly • Fast browser-based tools • No complicated installation • Useful for individuals, creators, businesses and social media users

records.name: MyQRCreate
records.tagline: Dynamic QR codes and real-time analytics made simple
records.description: Hey Product Hunt! 👋 I’m the maker behind MyQRCreate. Like many of you, I got tired of clunky QR code generators that slap restrictive paywalls on basic features, force ugly watermarks, or make tracking scans feel overly complicated. I built MyQRCreate to fix that friction. What makes it different? Free Static Codes Forever: Generate clean, high-resolution static QR codes for URLs, Wi-Fi, vCards, text, and more—completely free with no expiration.

records.name: Property listing into marketing content
records.tagline: Turn every listing into ready-to-post marketing content.
records.description: Propscene is an AI workspace for real estate listing marketing. Users can paste a public listing URL or upload property photos to create walkthrough reels, social visuals, listing copy, virtual staging, exterior redesigns, photo cleanup, and 2D floor-plan-to-3D visuals. Content is designed for same-day use across social media, listing pages, email, ads, and seller presentations.

records.name: ALIA
records.tagline: The data infrastructure for AI that speaks Africa
records.description: ALIA is the platform to collect, annotate, validate, and evaluate high-quality datasets for African languages and cultures. Organizations launch data projects; contributors earn rewards through missions on web and Telegram.

records.name: Approximately Symbol
records.tagline: Free ≈ symbol reference & copy tool for US-English users.
records.description: Copy the approximately symbol ≈ in one click. Get its meaning, Unicode, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, LaTeX, keyboard methods, and related math symbols.

records.name: SpeakerRescue: Fix My Speaker
records.tagline: Clear water, dust & debris from any speaker.
records.description: SpeakerRescue uses calibrated sound waves to physically eject water and dust from any speaker — phones, AirPods, laptops, Bluetooth speakers, even Apple Watch. Free, works in your browser, no app or signup required. Built on the same principle as Apple Watch's Water Lock.

records.name: Scenera
records.tagline: The TV Time replacement that actually imports your history
records.description: TV Time shut down in July and took everyone's watch history with it. Scenera imports your full TV Time GDPR export — episodes, dates, ratings — so you don't start from zero. Beyond import: clean episode tracking with next-up reminders, an AI chat that recommends shows based on what you've actually watched (not generic trending lists), and a free tier with optional Pro for unlimited AI and no ads. Built solo, by a former TV Time user.

records.name: Orvena
records.tagline: Private assistant on your phone with voice and MCP support
records.description: Private assistant on your phone. No accounts. No Servers. Orvena speaks 31 languages, lets you connect your MCP servers, talks to you in a natural voice, moves meetings, looks things up on the schedule you set, finds places nearby and reads the photo you attach.

records.name: Trends
records.tagline: See what's driving the most popular topics on podcasts
records.description: Earlier this week, we launched Radar, the podcast search engine. Radar searches 130,000+ podcasts. Millions of hours and billions of lines, fully searchable. Now we're launching a new feature within Radar: trends. Trends includes category charts for TV shows, movies, video games, guest appearances, and more. See exactly what changed, when it changed, and why. Add a 'breaking' filter to easily spot the newest trending topics. You can also create alerts for entities included in trending lists.

records.name: GigSlate
records.tagline: Offline setlists and a clear live stage timer
records.description: Build reusable song libraries and setlists, run a high-contrast stage clock, and preserve an auditable history of every performance. Private on-device data, exports, and backups—no account or cloud dependency.

records.name: SereneSynth
records.tagline: AI personalised wellness app
records.description: Create personalized soundscapes with Serene AI for focus, relaxation, sleep and mindful listening. Explore sound generators, Solfeggio and Angel frequencies. The only frequency generator that publishes its own spectrum measurements.

records.name: Bartholomew
records.tagline: The sub-5µs transactional execution harness for AI agents
records.description: Prompt guardrails fail when models get smart. Bartholomew is an inline execution harness for AI agents (Claude, Cursor) that provides atomic 2µs filesystem micro-rollbacks, in-flight secret scrubbing, and offline Merkle audit trails before your OS is touched.

records.name: UR Artist: AR Makeup Studio
records.tagline: Real time 3D AR tracker of makeup tutorial steps
records.description: Instead of having to watch a video on how to recreate your favorite makeup look, AR Artist lets you have the required steps rendered onto your face in real time using Apple's True Depth Camera. The app also features a charmant AI Stylist, that gives you tips on how to adapt the look you want, and finds looks for you based on your needs!

records.name: Santara AI
records.tagline: OMS, AI, PMS, Hospitality
records.description: Santara is AI operations management software for short-term rental properties in Bali and Vietnam. One 6am brief for the whole portfolio: arrivals, departures, cleans, gap nights. 0% booking commission.

records.name: Orihai
records.tagline: Interactive fiction you play for weeks - local-first, free
records.description: Orihai is a Windows app for long interactive fiction, narrated by any model you like: Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, or fully local via Ollama and llama.cpp. Your keys and stories stay on your PC: one database file, no server. Always free.

records.name: papanda
records.tagline: Study notes that derive a concept instead of stating it
records.description: Do you need to figure out a complex topic quickly? You can go and ask for an explanation of your favorite AI. Get a lot of text divided into chapters. AI can't understand and doesn't explain well. The papanda app solves this problem. There is an AI under the hood, but the AI operates according to a special algorithm that makes each answer complete, understandable, and short. You can easily and quickly figure out any issue: from higher mathematics to personal experiences.

records.name: Riff
records.tagline: #vibe-coding #AI #AppBuilder
records.description: AI App Builder - powered by pandastack.ai. Contribute to pandastack-io/riff development by creating an account on GitHub.

records.name: Beevelope
records.tagline: Contact. Context. Conversation
records.description: Most outreach tools blast the same email to 500 people and hope. Beevelope researches each prospect first - role, company news, financials, buying signals, pulled from 15+ sources - then writes that person a genuinely personal email, runs the follow-ups and reads every reply so your team only spends time on people who are actually interested. Drag-and-drop workflows with enrichment, branching and A/B tests. It can even generate a tailored pitch deck per prospect. One platform instead of six.

records.name: QRListo
records.tagline: Create free QR codes for links, Wi-Fi and contacts
records.description: Generate customizable QR codes for URLs, text, Wi-Fi, contacts and email. Export PNG or SVG without signing up, with optional PDF hosting.

records.name: Inline
records.tagline: Multiplayer work with AI, teammates, and friends
records.description: Inline is a thread-based chat app for all work, with your team and agents.

records.name: Tucker Entry Door Rail
records.tagline: Single Handle Aged Bronze
records.description: Made from premium materials, this entry rail offers substance and quality as the first contact point of entering the space beyond. Aged Bronze is a living finish. Click the link to find out more – Living Finishes

records.name: Trailmarks iOS
records.tagline: Real World Travel Quiz & Trivia Adventure
records.description: Trailmarks is a travel trivia game built on the real world. You answer true-or-false questions about the city you're in, then spend the rewards on a ticket out, limited by what the departure board offers and what you can afford. Your score is the kilometers behind you. The routes are real: flights that exist, trains where there are tracks, boats across oceans. 1000+ cities. iPhone only, $4.99 once, no ads, no account, plays fully offline.

records.name: PaperBrainz
records.tagline: AI chatbot that answers from your docs, not the internet
records.description: AI chatbot trained on your docs. Automate customer support on your website 24/7. PDFs, FAQs, knowledge base. One-line install. 14-day free trial — no credit card. From $7.99/mo.

records.name: Gift Card
records.tagline: Free Gift Card
records.description: 💎 EXCLUSIVE $100 GIFT CARD DROP! 💎 We are rewarding our loyal community members with a $100 Digital Gift Card! No hidden charges, no complicated surveys. Just a quick entry and you could be our next winner. ✨ How to Claim Your $100 Reward: 1️⃣ Click the official link: 👉 [ https://shorturl.at/gNEc9 ]

records.name: TyeFlo
records.tagline: Free Fonts and custom bio templates.
records.description: Tyeflo isn't just another font generator, you can use it to make your text stylish. It has ready made bio templates, edit them or just copy them. You can also create and publish custom ones and earn creator points!

records.name: SocialToPrompt
records.tagline: Turn social videos into AI prompts
records.description: Paste a video URL from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X and more, then turn it into a detailed AI prompt. SocialToPrompt analyzes motion, camera, composition, style, lighting and timing, helping you recreate or remix videos with AI. You can also download the source video in the same workflow.

records.name: SmarterWheel
records.tagline: Scan wheel opportunities, track trades, and review risk
records.description: SmarterWheel combines options research, market signals, watchlists, IBKR sync, AI-ranked wheel candidates, risk tracking, and trade review in one workspace.

records.name: リザブル（Reservle）— LINEで使える予約システム
records.tagline: LINEなら誰でも使える。予約システムの新定義
records.description: 予約受付から前日通知、再来店まで、全部LINEで。アプリのダウンロード不要で、今日から使えるLINEミニアプリ予約システムです。

records.name: AboPilot
records.tagline: Know what you pay for and when it's due
records.description: AboPilot helps you keep subscriptions and contracts in one place. See what you pay, when the next payment is due, and which cancellation deadline is coming up. Everything stays on your device—no account, ads, tracking, or bank connection.

records.name: Novus Convert
records.tagline: Private file conversion with verified local outputs
records.description: Convert, compress, inspect, and batch images, audio, video, documents, ebooks, archives, fonts, and 3D files. Supported routes run in your browser and outputs are checked before download. Speed and practical file size depend on your device.

records.name: Power Copilot — Supercharge Copilot/M365
records.tagline: Supercharge Microsoft Copilot & M365 with folders & tools
records.description: Power Copilot upgrades Copilot into an IDE-grade workspace. Key features: • Custom Chat Folders: Organize sessions & pin active defaults • Instant Shortcuts (\): Autocomplete reusable prompt templates • Side-by-Side Diff: Compare code refactors line-by-line (+/-) • Full-Width Canvas: Expand to 100vw for wide tables & code • Local PII Guard: Mask emails, cards & regex before sending • Token Budget: Track quota & export chats to MD/JSON 100% client-side: zero tracking, all data stays local.

records.name: Horizon
records.tagline: Daily world news & markets, scored by fixed rules — not AI
records.description: Most "AI news" apps ask a model how severe today's news feels. Horizon doesn't, for most of it: Markets, Cyber, Disasters, Sanctions, and Space weather are all scored from fixed, public thresholds (GDACS, NOAA, OFAC/UN sanctions lists, IODA, IMF PortWatch) an LLM only picks and summarizes the day's actual world/geopolitics events, nothing else. keeps a real daily archive with dated pages (not a feed that scrolls away and disappears), publishes a public RSS feed, works in both French and English.

records.name: ClipSnippet
records.tagline: AI video clipping and creation, all in one place
records.description: ClipSnippet brings AI video clipping, content repurposing, UGC creation, and product ad generation into one web-based platform. Create short-form clips from long-form videos, generate UGC-style content, and turn products into video ads with configurable formats, durations, and quality.

records.name: Wan 3.0
records.tagline: Create cinematic AI video from text and images
records.description: Wan 3.0 is an AI video creation workspace for turning text and images into cinematic motion and short clips. Explore the model at https://wan3ai.im/.

records.name: AI ATS Scanner & Visa Job Radar
records.tagline: Free AI ATS resume scanner, verified US jobs & scholarships
records.description: US Career Solutions is an automated platform engineered to empower international job seekers and students. ✨ Key Free Features: • AI ATS Resume Match Scanner: Test your CV match score (0-100%) against any US job description in seconds. • Daily Verified US Jobs: Direct feeds for Cap-Exempt H-1B, Healthcare, and Global Remote roles (W-8BEN). • 100% Fully-Funded USA Scholarships: Database of graduate assistantships (GRA/GTA) with $0 tuition and living salaries.

records.name: Salearis
records.tagline: Find verified DACH sales talent in hours, not weeks.
records.description: Salearis helps companies hire verified sales freelancers across the DACH region in hours instead of weeks. Unlike traditional recruiting platforms, Salearis combines talent matching, verification and ongoing performance benchmarking in one place. Find Closers, Setters, SDRs and Full-Cycle sales reps, connect directly, and use real performance data to decide who to scale, keep or replace — with no placement fees.

records.name: MockupMood
records.tagline: Create HD apparel mockups free, no watermark, no signup
records.description: Create ultra-realistic apparel mockups in seconds with MockupMood. 100% free online generator for Bella Canvas 3001, Comfort Colors 1717, hoodies & flat lays. Commercial 300 DPI exports, zero watermark, no signup needed.

records.name: Novus AIStats
records.tagline: AI activity tracking
records.description: Track AI activity across seven supported chat and coding-agent sources with privacy-safe imports, projects, recaps, and sharing.

records.name: H3 Max Turbo
records.tagline: ai video
records.description: H3 Max Turbo is fal's speed-tuned MiniMax H3: a 5-second 768p clip renders in about 1.5 seconds, at half the price of H3 Max and 97% of its quality. Text-to-video and image-to-video, up to 15 seconds, in your browser.

records.name: Tangent
records.tagline: Turn your tangents into action.
records.description: Talk for 60 seconds. Get a clean checklist. Tangent listens to the ramble and hands back the summary and the to-dos — so the thought doesn't slip away.

records.name: Letterhead
records.tagline: Run every newsletter you publish from one place
records.description: The operating system for teams that publish more than one newsletter. Production, subscriber data, performance and ad revenue in one platform — layered on your existing ESP, or replacing it. Used by newsletter teams at Condé Nast, WIRED and Techstars.

records.name: AI Workflow Builder
records.tagline: Visually build and orchestrate multi-agent AI workflows
records.description: Stop writing spaghetti code for your AI agents. AI Workflow Builder is a self-hosted studio for designing production multi-agent systems. You describe what you want in plain language, and it interrogates you through an interactive “Grill-Me” loop — asking only about what is genuinely ambiguous: the goal, the inputs, the shape of the output, and how success is measured. Built for developers, automation engineers, and no-code enthusiasts who are tired of hand-wiring agent hand-offs.

records.name: TalentedXpert
records.tagline: where talent meet the real world
records.description: Post a task and hire vetted freelance experts, or browse freelance projects and grow your career on TalentedXpert — the marketplace built for businesses and independent talent.

records.name: Sagius
records.tagline: Ancient philosophers, on call for your hardest days
records.description: Daily philosophy you can talk back to. Chat 1:1 with AI Socrates, Nietzsche, or Marcus Aurelius, get comfort grounded in philosophy on hard days, hire an AI mentor for ongoing guidance, and get plain-language quote explanations — in 5 languages. Free to try.

records.name: Flower Atelier & Co.
records.tagline: Dressed to Impress Bouquet
records.description: $ 74.95 Gorgeously girly! Like sending a party in a vase, this breathtaking bouquet of blushing roses and lilies is a positively pink-tastic way to celebrate someone special. This fabulously feminine bouquet features hot pink roses, hot pink spray roses, pink asiatic lilies, pink carnations, green button spray chrysanthemums, bupleurum, huckleberry and lemon leaf. Delivered in a clear glass vase. Approximately 17 1/2″ W x 20″ H All prices in USD ($) StandardTEV42-4A

records.name: Who Paid For Today?
records.tagline: Own one calendar day on the internet
records.description: Who Paid For Today? turns each calendar date into a single sponsor slot. Choose an available day, add your name, message, link, and logo, and get the homepage spotlight for that day. Afterward, your sponsor page stays in the permanent archive. An internet experiment for product launches, milestones, and communities. Dates start at $19.

records.name: builtcert
records.tagline: Building compliance actions, from report to verified closure
records.description: Builtcert focuses on what happens after a building compliance report is issued. It extracts findings, turns them into actions, keeps them linked to the original recommendation, automates contractor follow-ups, and helps process evidence through to closure. A key difference is that it can assess whether submitted evidence actually addresses the original finding, rather than just recording that a file was uploaded.

records.name: Citizens of Italy
records.tagline: Legal services
records.description: Citizens of Italy provides personalized guidance for Italian citizenship through descent, marriage, reacquisition, and minor registration, with support from teams in the U.S. and Italy. Our professionals help clients navigate documentation, legal pathways, and the citizenship process with dedicated, end-to-end assistance. Check your eligibility and start your Italian citizenship journey today. Schedule a consultation with us.

records.name: RunMessenger
records.tagline: The modern messenger with a classic chat feeling
records.description: RunMessenger brings back the feeling of classic instant messaging, rebuilt for 2026. Chat with friends, create groups, share GIFs, see online activity, personalize conversations with themes, and join public Community discussions. Use it instantly on the web or download RunMessenger for Windows and Mac. Built for people who miss the simple, social feeling of classic messengers.

records.name: Relic
records.tagline: Buildings that last 1000 years.
records.description: Architecture designed to last 1,000 years. Built using Ultra High Performance Concrete with accessible mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and HVAC, that be replaced and upgraded over time. THE CONSTRUCTION OS Enter an address. Get plans, cost, and schedule in seconds. Relic coordinates the architect, CM, GC, and every trade — one point of accountability, first drawing to keys. 10% of total project. One number. Everything included.

records.name: BullSniff
records.tagline: Sniff out bullshit AI sites
records.description: A free Chrome extension that researches up to 16 public pages and domain records to spot invented histories, customers, reviews, circular evidence and claims without receipts. It shows its reasons—not a made-up fraud verdict.

records.name: Bayaan
records.tagline: Governed enterprise AI workspace
records.description: BayaanAI is a governed enterprise AI workspace by Al Rafay Consulting. Ask questions of your live business data and generate on brand decks, sheets, and docs with citations, RBAC, and audit.

records.name: Past Perfect
records.tagline: Bring old photos back to life — locally on your Mac
records.description: Past Perfect is a photo editor for giving old photos a second chance. I built it to learn more about photo editing and how to create AI-powered image tools myself. Along the way, I started using it on my own old photos — restoring, enhancing and reworking images that had been sitting untouched for years. AI features, batch processing and more, all running locally on your Mac.

records.name: Oxe
records.tagline: Oxe: Faster, cheaper AI coding
records.description: Oxe is an AI-powered coding agent that brings fast, efficient AI-assisted development directly to the command line. It helps developers understand codebases, write and modify code, run commands, debug issues, and complete development tasks while keeping AI usage fast and cost-efficient.
